purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 18-record item effect batch 017; together these files contain exactly 18 self-contained reviewed records.

items/golden-orb-of-siluvanede.name: Golden Orb of Siluvanede
items/golden-orb-of-siluvanede.effectSummary: The orb continuously protects its owner and can absorb and negate one spell or spell-like ability that targets the owner each day. The owner chooses whether to expend the daily protection on an incoming effect, but the orb provides no special information identifying that effect beforehand.

items/halruaan-skyship.name: Halruaan Skyship
items/halruaan-skyship.effectSummary: Ten levitation plates keep the sailing ship airborne and prevent it from entering water normally, while a linked control rod governs vertical movement at 45 feet. Horizontal travel depends on wind and sails with clumsy maneuverability; the magic weakens with altitude, so the ship normally remains within 100 feet of the ground, where its cargo capacity is 15 tons.

items/nolzurs-marvelous-pigments.name: Nolzur's Marvelous Pigments
items/nolzurs-marvelous-pigments.effectSummary: One pot can turn a two-dimensional painting covering up to 100 square feet into up to 1,000 cubic feet of permanent normal inanimate matter after 10 minutes of painting. The pigments cannot create creatures or magic items; apparently valuable substances become cheap substitutes, and mundane weapons, armor, or other items created cannot exceed 2,000 gp in value.

items/orb-of-holiness.name: Orb of Holiness
items/orb-of-holiness.effectSummary: An evil creature touching the orb must make Will DC 25, taking 4d6 damage and feeblemind on a failure or 2d6 damage and 1d4 rounds of daze on a success. A good holder can use hold monster (DC 17) and purify food and drink once per day each; a good follower of the orb's deity also gains cure serious wounds three times per day and regenerate once per day. The orb continuously emits prayer, automatically counters and dispels fear effects within 60 feet, and can deal 5d6 damage to undead with a successful touch attack.

items/powerstoring-674.name: Power Storing
items/powerstoring-674.effectSummary: A power storing weapon holds one targeted power costing up to 5 power points with a 1-standard-action manifesting time. After the weapon damages a creature, the wielder may manifest the stored power on that creature as a swift action; the weapon then becomes empty and can receive another eligible power. It telepathically tells the wearer the name of the stored power.

items/ribbonweave-589.name: Ribbonweave
items/ribbonweave-589.effectSummary: In its compact form the weapon functions as a club; a free-action catch releases its sharp flexible ribbon. A wielder can use Weapon Finesse with a properly sized ribbonweave even though it is not light, but cannot wield it two-handed for 1-1/2 Strength damage. Recognizing it as a weapon requires a DC 18 Search check.

items/salve-of-slipperiness.name: Salve of Slipperiness
items/salve-of-slipperiness.effectSummary: An anointed creature gains +20 competence on Escape Artist checks and is unaffected by webs, magical ropes, and similar restraints. Applied to a floor or steps, the salve acts as a long-lasting grease effect. It lasts 8 hours on a creature unless removed with an alcohol solution.

items/sovereign-glue.name: Sovereign Glue
items/sovereign-glue.effectSummary: One ounce covers 1 square foot and permanently bonds virtually any two substances after 1 round. Pulling the objects apart before it sets ruins that application; after it sets, separating them normally rends one object instead, and universal solvent is the exception that dissolves the bond. A found flask holds 1 to 7 ounces and requires an oil-of-slipperiness-coated interior.

items/spell-storing-161.name: Spell Storing
items/spell-storing-161.effectSummary: A spell storing weapon holds one targeted spell of up to 3rd level with a 1-standard-action casting time. After the weapon damages a creature, the wielder may immediately cast the stored spell on that creature as a free action; the weapon then becomes empty and can receive another eligible spell. It magically tells the wielder the name of the stored spell.
